title: VESPER State-Domain Lease
description: REM-002 §4.1-4.3. Exactly one holder per state domain per instant. The lease is what makes 'who may write this' a fact rather than a convention, and `epoch` is what makes it enforceable after a partition heals. Authority: DR-002, DR-017, DR-022, ARCH-24, SR-019, SR-058; ADR-012, ADR-002 D3.

domain.description: The seven domains of REM-002 §4.1. Closed enum: a new domain is a REM-002 change, not a configuration value, because each domain carries its own non-owner behaviour and rejoin rule.

state.description: SM-LEASE. OWNED_MANUAL is distinct from OWNED so that an operator promotion made without quorum is never mistaken for an automatic one.

holder.description: node_id per ADR-007 D1: a fingerprint of a public key, never a self-asserted name. Null exactly when state is UNOWNED.

epoch.description: INV-OWN-3 fencing token. Monotonically increasing, never reused, incremented on every acquisition. Every write to this domain carries it, and the storage layer rejects stale-epoch writes in a single conditional statement (ADR-002 D3). A read-then-write implementation of the same check is a race and is non-compliant.

ttl_ms.description: Holder self-demotes at TTL rather than continuing to write hopefully. Value is owner configuration (REM-002 §14.2); the obligation to have one is not.

renewed_at_wall.description: WALL-CLOCK-OK: TTL expiry is a local-monotonic concern, not a cross-node ordering concern. This field never participates in ordering or supersession (INV-COORD-4).

mode.description: DF-PROMOTE. AUTOMATIC requires a quorum of reachable ENROLLED nodes. Lease expiry without quorum is OPERATOR_CONFIRMED only -- a node that cannot see its peers cannot distinguish 'they are down' from 'I am isolated', and must never resolve that ambiguity in its own favour.

partition_suspected.description: When true, DF-PROMOTE returns NO_PROMOTION on every side. Partition is not evidence of failure.

fenced_reason.description: Set when a returning holder whose lease expired during partition is FENCED. Its uncommitted writes are queued as ordinary writes subject to supersession, never applied with owner authority.

$comment: STRUCTURALLY UNEXPRESSIBLE BY DESIGN: (1) an OWNED lease with no holder; (2) an OWNED_MANUAL lease claiming AUTOMATIC promotion -- which is how a no-quorum self-promotion would have to be recorded, so it cannot be recorded at all; (3) a FENCED lease with no reason. INV-OWN-1 and INV-OWN-2 are therefore schema properties, not review obligations.
